newsitem.title: CANADA: Discovery West spin-off firm to trade.
newsitem.headline: Discovery West spin-off firm to trade.

text.p: Discovery West Corp said on Thursday that BlackRock Ventures Inc, which was spun off from Discovery West in the company's reorganization, received conditional approval to trade on the Toronto Stock Exchange.
Discovery West said BlackRock shares were expected to trade on a when-issued basis starting on October 24.
BlackRock acquired a 65 percent interest from Discovery West in an oil sands lease near Cold Lake, Alberta containing an estimated 700 million barrels of bitumen in place, the company said.
The new firm also owns an 18.8 percent stake in Rayrock Yellowknife Resources Inc and minor oil and gas properties.
Under the deal, Discovery West shareholders will receive one Black Rock share for each Discovery share held on October 28, it said.
